design_detail: 0.5% wealth levy on net movable assets over Rs 1 million via Income Support Levy Act, 2013
quote_original: Besides other taxation measures like withdrawal of exemptions, the hallmark of the taxation side was a one per cent increase in general sales tax on all sales -- from 16 to 17pc. It will fetch over Rs50bn. Wealth tax has been revived.
source_title: Bid to grapple with economic mess: Dar announces wide-ranging taxes
grading_note: Finance Minister announcing enactment of Income Support Levy Act, 2013, levying 0.5% on net movable wealth over Rs 1 million.

design_detail: Wealth tax to compensate for revenue lost from reducing production and energy taxes
quote_original: In an interview with an international news service, Bloomberg, he said the move will help cover up the lost revenue by introducing a wealth tax.
source_title: PTI govt to reduce taxes on energy supply, factories, agriculture: Asad
grading_note: Incoming Finance Minister announcing policy plans in media interview to introduce a wealth tax.

design_detail: Wealth tax to steer the country out of prevailing economic challenges
quote_original: He supported the proposals of reducing withholding taxes, reforms in capital gain tax, and introduction of wealth tax and inheritance tax.
source_title: Govt will make efforts to develop economic consensus: Asad Umar
grading_note: Federal Finance Minister confirming plan to introduce wealth tax at public policy institute event.

design_detail: Compulsory wealth tax targeting 700,000 affluent households identified by NADRA and FBR
quote_original: If the government desired to generate revenues in an equitable manner, it should have reintroduced wealth tax to target 700,000 families that have been identified by National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) and the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) which are affluent but avoiding taxes, said Bengali, while speaking at a press conference at the Karachi Press Club on Friday.
source_title: Government misses chance to slap wealth tax
grading_note: Prominent economist presenting detailed alternative revenue proposal demanding compulsory wealth tax on affluent households.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax with transparent accountability and progressive thresholds
quote_original: In a context marked by deepening fiscal constraint, wealth taxes offer a potential solution, as they have done in many other countries... Over 40pc of respondents back the introduction of a new general wealth tax — a figure that, while not overwhelming, suggests such proposals are far from the political non-starters they’re often assumed to be.
source_title: Pakistan's support for wealth taxes
grading_note: Academic co-author of nationwide survey and op-ed arguing for progressive wealth taxation in Pakistan.

design_detail: Design and public support framework for wealth taxation in Pakistan based on 7,500 adult survey
quote_original: Drawing on a nationally representative survey of 7,500 individuals, this brief explores public support for wealth taxation and the factors that shape those attitudes in Pakistan... support for wealth taxation is higher than may be commonly assumed... support is not driven by self-interest: higher income individuals are in fact more supportive of wealth taxes
source_title: Public Support for Wealth and Progressive Taxes in Pakistan
publisher: International Centre for Tax and Development
grading_note: Tax research institute publishing policy brief demonstrating survey support and roadmap for progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the super-rich, landlords, and big corporations
quote_original: In closing remarks, Farooq Tariq (Pakistan) emphasised that wealth tax should be viewed as an equitable measure that enforces more taxation on the wealthy. He framed wealth tax as a political issue, shedding light on the broader implications and power dynamics at play.
source_title: Wealth tax for an equitable society
publisher: South Asia Alliance for Poverty Eradication
grading_note: Left party president advocating wealth tax on the super-rich at civil society consultation.

design_detail: Direct tax on accumulated wealth and large estates
quote_original: Now it is true that many here do not pay their taxes and it is the need of the hour but are we talking of things such as wealth tax and property tax or taxing the poor and salaried classes?
source_title: Budget 2019-20: Economists call for direct taxes on wealth
grading_note: Economist calling for direct tax on accumulated wealth at post-budget press club forum.

design_detail: Revival of Wealth Tax Act to document undocumented economy and tax rich
quote_original: Progressive taxes like wealth tax, estate duty, capital gain on immovable property and gift tax were abolished to benefit the rich. This has distorted the entire tax system, created income inequalities, widened the rich-poor divide and retarded economic growth.
source_title: Reviving wealth tax
grading_note: Supreme Court tax counsel advocating revival of the Wealth Tax Act in national press.

grading_note: Supreme Court tax counsel co-authoring op-ed advocating revival of the Wealth Tax Act.

design_detail: Government advisory recommendation to revive wealth tax in federal budget
quote_original: The EAC and RAC in a meeting held this month asked the government to consider revival of wealth tax, implement existing laws by the provinces to collect agriculture income tax from land holdings of over 50 acres, evolve consensus on RGST as well as with provinces to bring services into the tax net, rationalize tariff regime, and plug leakages for broadening the tax base to overcome fiscal woes.
source_title: Reviving wealth tax
grading_note: Federal advisory council formally recommending reintroduction of wealth tax to government.

design_detail: Revival of Wealth Tax Act 1963 to tax undisclosed asset creation and fund social services
quote_original: The Wealth Tax Act 1963 was also abolished through the Finance Act 2003. The repeal of this progressive law, especially suitable for Pakistan where enormous assets are created without disclosing income, was shown to be justified despite tremendous revenue losses and the ensuing misery inflicted on the majority of the people... Higher rates of income taxes, capital transfer taxes and wealth taxes are some means adopted for achieving these ends in all democratic countries.
source_title: Reforming the tax system
grading_note: Tax Bar Association General Secretary publishing op-ed in Dawn calling for revival of the Wealth Tax Act.

design_detail: Re-imposition of wealth tax, inheritance tax and estate duties instead of indirect taxes
quote_original: Dr Tahir was addressing the participants of the third Asma Jahangir Memorial Lecture organised by the Human Rights Commission of Pakistan... Wealth tax, inheritance tax and estate duties need to be re-imposed, he said, adding that there should be no increase in indirect taxes.
source_title: Resumption of trade with India urged to address people's woes
grading_note: Former Chief Economist calling for re-imposing wealth tax at Human Rights Commission memorial lecture.

design_detail: Wealth tax on big feudals and landlords as alternative to consumer sales tax
quote_original: The proposed suggestions include, wealth tax on big feudals and landlords, agricultural tax, stoppage of additional-benefits in agriculture, deduction in non-development funds, an end for corruption, reforms in public and private sectors and a review of Afghan-transit agreement. Sattar further said that the government had been cautioned numerously about the consequences of RGST, and that it will bring a tsunami of inflation for the people of the country. He demanded for the implementation of suggestions by MQM, in order to bring relief to the people.
source_title: MQM proposes alternative for RGST
grading_note: Parliamentary leader announcing alternative party fiscal package submitted to Prime Minister proposing wealth tax.

design_detail: Alternative party proposal to federal government for wealth tax on big feudals

source_title: MQM proposes alternative for RGST
grading_note: Political party formal submission to Prime Minister proposing wealth tax on big feudals.

design_detail: Adoption of wealth tax on billionaires to raise revenues for public services
quote_original: Pakistan KissanRabita Committee (PKRC), and Crofter Foundation... They also called for the adoption of a wealth tax and recovery of ill-gotten weath of billionaires to raise more revenues to fund public services.
source_title: Peoples' groups and movements denounce deepening inequality, say it's time to tax the rich, not the poor
publisher: Asian Peoples' Movement on Debt and Development
grading_note: Peasant network leading nationwide protests calling for wealth tax on billionaires.

design_detail: 2% to 5% annual wealth tax on multi-millionaires and billionaires
quote_original: Oxfam has proposed imposition of wealth tax of 2 to 5 per cent on Asia-Pacific's multi-millionaires and billionaires that could raise an additional $776.5 billion every year to increase public spending on health in the region by 60pc.
source_title: Oxfam proposes wealth tax on Asia-Pacific's rich
grading_note: NGO report launch from Islamabad proposing 2% to 5% wealth tax on billionaires and multi-millionaires.

design_detail: 1% wealth tax on documented net movable and immovable assets above Rs 100m plus capital value tax on foreign assets
quote_original: Similarly, an effective wealth tax based on a one-percent levy on documented net movable and immovable assets above Rs100 million, together with a capital value tax on foreign assets, has been estimated to generate Rs50–90 billion during the initial period and Rs100–160 billion on an annualised basis within 24 months.
source_title: Around Rs1.5trn revenue gap: Govt mulls PL replacement with new tax steps
grading_note: Formal economic policy proposal submitted by Jamaat-e-Islami specifying 1% rate, Rs 100m threshold, movable and immovable asset base.

design_detail: Leader of Jamaat-e-Islami presenting alternative fiscal package replacing petroleum levy with 1% wealth tax on assets over Rs 100m
quote_original: Similarly, an effective wealth tax based on a one-percent levy on documented net movable and immovable assets above Rs100 million, together with a capital value tax on foreign assets, has been estimated to generate Rs50–90 billion during the initial period and Rs100–160 billion on an annualised basis within 24 months.
source_title: Around Rs1.5trn revenue gap: Govt mulls PL replacement with new tax steps
grading_note: Party leader presenting and sponsoring comprehensive revenue replacement package including wealth tax.

design_detail: Revival of wealth tax covering all kinds of moveable and immovable properties
quote_original: Senator Sughra Iman said that Finance Minister as opposition member had always remained a strong advocate of reviving wealth tax, but appears to be in no mood to impose wealth tax after coming into power, "which can cover all kinds of moveable and immovable properties."
source_title: Dar criticised for failing to revive wealth tax, raising GIDC
grading_note: Intervention in Senate Standing Committee on Finance demanding revival of wealth tax on movable and immovable properties; source uses typographical spelling 'Iman'.

design_detail: Introducing wealth and inheritance taxes, closing loopholes, taxing offshore assets
quote_original: Recommendations from the workshop included introducing wealth and inheritance taxes, closing loopholes, taxing offshore assets, and reinvesting revenues into public services.
source_title: Reclaiming Public Wealth through an Equitable Tax System in South Asia
publisher: South Asia Alliance for Poverty Eradication
grading_note: Regional civil society conference recommendations calling for wealth and inheritance taxes.
